features:
Features

Crunchy, whole-grain oats: Made with real whole-grain oats and honey—each serving contains 16 g of whole grain.

Simple, clean ingredients: No artificial flavors, colors, gelatin, or high-fructose corn syrup.

Individually wrapped twin bars: Comes with two bars per pack for easy portioning and portability.

Allergen transparency: Contains soy; may contain peanuts, almonds, and pecans. 

Benefits

Portable snack: Ideal for work, school, hikes, or travel—easy to toss in a bag or lunchbox.

Whole-grain boost: Provides 16 g of whole grains per serving to help support daily nutritional needs.

Clean-label appeal: Made with simple, recognizable ingredients like oats and real honey—great for health-conscious consumers.

Well-loved flavor: Consistently praised for its satisfying crunch and naturally sweet taste from honey.
ingredients:
Whole Grain Oats, Sugar, Canola and/or Sunflower Oil, Rice Flour, Honey, Salt, Brown Sugar Syrup, Baking Soda, Soy Lecithin, Natural Flavor.

Contains soy; may contain peanut, almond and pecan ingredients.
